name: Password reset endpoints fail when oobCode is already consumed (consolidated)
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/magic-link-errors.feature.spec.js › Magic Link Error Handling › Password reset endpoints fail when oobCode is already consumed (consolidated)

steps.name: Given real COMPANY credentials are available
And the real company user is signed in for magic-link testing
And the Firebase user has emailVerified set to true
And the password reset cooldown is cleared
When I generate a password reset oobCode via test endpoint
When the password is reset via confirm-password-reset to "NewSecureE2ePass1"
Then the response status should be 200
expected 200; response body: {"success":true,"message":"Password has been reset successfully","data":{"email":"e2e.company@test.com"}}
When the extracted oobCode is checked via verify-reset-code
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-13T09:07:27.698","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/verify-reset-code","requestId":"REQ-7f8f5de1","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the response messageKey should be "error.auth.invalid_action_code"

messageKey in: {"timestamp":"2026-10-13T09:07:27.698","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/verify-reset-code","requestId":"REQ-7f8f5de1","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
When the password is reset via confirm-password-reset to "AnotherPass1"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-13T09:07:27.712","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-815fd3e8","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the response messageKey should be "error.auth.invalid_action_code"

messageKey in: {"timestamp":"2026-10-13T09:07:27.712","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-815fd3e8","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the original password is restored
login with the RESTORED password must succeed
